title: ChatGPT in Teaching and Learning: A Systematic Review
authors: Duha Ali; Yasin Fatemi; Elahe Boskabadi; Mohsen Nikfar; Jude Ugwuoke; Haneen Ali
text: The increasing use of artificial intelligence in education has raised questions about the implications of ChatGPT for teaching and learning. This systematic review examines evidence and challenges associated with ChatGPT in educational settings.
